Relevant Seinfeld on Instagram: "One final Chuck Norris joke:
Chuck Norris doesn’t cheat death. He wins fair and square.

RIP Chuck

Some of my favorite childhood memories were sitting around the TV on Friday night with my dad and watching Walker, Texas Ranger. Loved watching Lone Wolf McQuade with my friends in college. Chuck, you are a legend in every sense of the word. My condolences to your family and friends."
